parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file passes. src/infrastructure/order-controller.ts is an Express HTTP adapter, which fits the infrastructure layer. Its responsibilities are all transport work: it maps routes to application service calls (OrderService and CatalogueService), pulls request parameters out of the body, query string and path, checks their shape (isState, orderId), and turns errors into HTTP 400 responses in handle(). Placing, listing, advancing and cancelling orders are all delegated to the application layer. The controller does not decide which state transitions are allowed or when an order may be cancelled. The `states` array repeats the OrderState values from the domain to check incoming strings. That is input parsing at the HTTP boundary, not a business rule, though in future it could drift out of sync with the domain type. Nothing here does persistence or domain logic.
